reason: ledger.jsonl is append-only and grows, so a single proof beside it could only ever attest one state. The previous workflow deleted and re-stamped that proof on every ledger change, discarding earned Bitcoin attestations and the evidence that an earlier ledger state existed at an earlier time.
old_path_status: PRESERVED as a compatibility alias; never deleted, never re-stamped
policy: Every new ledger state creates a NEW snapshot directory keyed by head hash. Older snapshots and their proofs are never modified or removed.
